fullHistory.content: Write a welcome message for this Roba Studio project. Start with 1–2 short, engaging sentences introducing yourself as Roba Copilot and mentioning the specific robot by name (e.g. "Hey! I'm Roba Copilot — your co-pilot for the Unitree G1. Here's what we can do together:"). Then show exactly 4 markdown sections with emoji headers: 🤖 Poses, ✋ Hands, 🎬 Animations, ⌨️ Code & Controls. Under each section list exactly 3 example prompts in double quotes — short, natural human phrasing like "Make it wave" or "Close the left fist", not code. No closing sentence.

Hey! I'm Roba Copilot — your co‑pilot for the PIB robot. Let’s explore what we can do together:

## 🤖 Poses
- "Raise the right arm forward"
- "Tilt the head left"
- "Put the robot in a T‑pose"

## ✋ Hands
- "Close the left fist"
- "Open the right hand"
- "Spread all fingers"

## 🎬 Animations
- "Wave the left arm"
- "Nod the head repeatedly"
- "Perform a side‑to‑side shrug"

## ⌨️ Code & Controls
- "Increase the shoulder vertical power"
- "Add a custom keyboard shortcut for raising the left arm"
- "Show the current ctrl values in the console"
